## 2. Staff record reconciliation

The employee ⟦PERSON|Colra Vennick⟧ requests correction of an omitted training entry. The employer, ⟦ORG|Reed Halo Instruments Ltd⟧ (the Employer), agrees to compare the attendance log against the personnel export before changing the record.

2.1 The export identifies the employee by **Personnel ID:** ⟦IDENTITY|IDENTITY_814672⟧. This is the identifier used by the employer's register. The uppercase prefix, underscore and digits together form the personal identifier appearing on the original export.

2.2 A correction must identify the course, attendance date and source of verification. The employer must retain the earlier entry and explain why it was incomplete. The correction must not imply that a certificate was issued on a date when only attendance was recorded.

2.3 A dispute about the pay consequences of the training is outside this reconciliation schedule. The schedule records the evidence available and does not itself settle the separate payment request.

See paragraph 5.1 for the confirmation procedure. The proposed completion date is 22 December 2026. The administrative allowance is GBP 25.
